$comment: Response schema sent to BOTH providers (Claude output_config.format, Gemini response_json_schema). One response per batch of items.

assumed_language.description: The language the content was judged as, e.g. 'Hindi' or 'English (India)' for 'IndianEnglish'.

can_judge.description: false if the language is not known well enough to review reliably.

note.description: Short explanation when can_judge is false; otherwise empty.

item_ids.description: IDs of the input lines this warning applies to.

text.description: The text exactly as written in the sheet.

suggestion.description: The corrected text, or empty if none.

reason.description: One short sentence for the content team.
